title: SOMNO-03 Sleep Architecture: Fix deep sleep calculation bug (15.3 hrs) and scale daily hours to 24-hour timeline
comments: Deep sleep in SOMNO-03 erroneously displays 15.3 hrs due to byte scaling/misaligned packet buffer multiplier (5-min block multiplier applied to raw minutes or payload offset shift). Sleep architecture timeline and stats must correctly scale to 24-hour daily cycle (0 to 24h) and accurately parse deep/light/REM/wake blocks from Veepoo 0xE0 sleep telemetry stream.

title: Watch Bluetooth Connectivity & UX: Remove confusing "Found a Watch" banner and enforce seamless background auto-connect
comments: User had to reset watch to re-establish connection. The "New Watch Transponder Detected / Found a Watch" prompt banner (#unlinkedBanner) is confusing and must be eliminated. The system should automatically and silently connect to the authorized watch whenever it is in range and immediately begin background data download without requiring manual user pairing clicks.

title: Database Deduplication: Enforce strict deduplication on watch telemetry packets and health tables
comments: Implement robust deduplication on all incoming watch packets and health telemetry records (glucose, BP, HR, SpO2, HRV, sleep epochs, steps). Use composite primary/unique keys (timestamp, metric_type) and INSERT OR IGNORE / INSERT OR REPLACE to prevent duplicate rows across repeated syncs, ensuring the local database remains clean and performant.

title: Daily Telemetry Charts Window: Dynamically anchor daily charts to today (0:00 to current time) instead of displaying yesterday data
comments: Daily charts across the LCARS interface are currently displaying yesterday complete 24-hour dataset instead of today active progress. Daily charts must be dynamically bound from 00:00 to the current wall-clock time (e.g. 0:00 to 9:26 AM), reflecting today real-time measurements and partial day accumulation.
